about.title: A dynamic Egyptian hospitality brand, founded in 2011.
about.text: Xperience offers international standards with regional expertise. Through a wide range of tailor-made services and diverse modern facilities, we raise the hospitality benchmark to meet every international traveller's needs — a proud member of Kiroseiz Group, with more than 30 years of development across the Red Sea.

resortsSection.title: Six ways to meet the Red Sea
resortsSection.lead: From a 21-slide aqua park to a hilltop hideaway, every Xperience resort sits minutes from the water in Sharm El Sheikh.

discover.title: Life at the resorts, in motion
discover.lead: Sun-soaked days, live shows, aqua-park thrills and unforgettable nights — straight from our resorts in Sharm El Sheikh.

aboutPage.heroSub: Founded in 2011, Xperience raises the hospitality benchmark on the Red Sea — international standards with genuine regional expertise.
aboutPage.whoLead: Xperience is a dynamic Egyptian hospitality brand, founded in January 2011, offering international standards with regional expertise. Through a wide range of tailor-made services and diverse modern facilities, we raise the hospitality benchmark to meet every traveller's needs.
aboutPage.whoBody: Xperience Hospitality Management is a member of Kiroseiz Group — which has developed and flourished across many fields over the past 30+ years.
aboutPage.susTitle: Committed to a greener Red Sea
aboutPage.susLead: We run our business through the Travelife Sustainability Program — focused on eco-efficiency, energy and water conservation, waste reduction and eco-purchasing.
aboutPage.resultsLead: Year-on-year savings from 2016 to 2017, alongside our ongoing conservation and community efforts.
aboutPage.policiesLead: Clear promises to our guests, our people, the environment and our community.
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Six resorts on the Red Sea await

meetingsPage.heroSub: The ideal mix of business excellence and comforting pleasure — a grand ballroom, dedicated planners and full catering, in the heart of Naama Bay.
meetingsPage.overviewLead: Our meetings and banquets at Xperience Kiroseiz Parkland promise the ideal mix of business excellence and comforting pleasure. Our grand ballroom proudly hosts functions of every genre — including a theatre layout for best business practice.
meetingsPage.overviewBody: The ballroom accommodates up to 270 attendants, where every business need is met and a wide variety of catering services is performed. We simply commit to crown your meeting, event or conference with success — and trademark it as topnotch.
meetingsPage.ballroomTitle: A stage set for every occasion
meetingsPage.panelBody: From boardroom briefings to gala dinners, the ballroom reconfigures to fit your agenda — with screens, sound, staging and a catering team on hand throughout.
meetingsPage.venuesLead: Conferences, celebrations, banquets and private functions — each planned end to end by our team.
meetingsPage.capacityLead: The grand ballroom adapts to four core setups. Capacities below are a guide — our planners will tailor the layout to your event.
meetingsPage.tableFoot: Reception & banquet layouts host up to 270 guests.
meetingsPage.weddingsLead: Celebrate your wedding, anniversary or special occasion in our venues, where our organiser and catering team come together to create one of the most original and unforgettable gatherings — seamless planning from start to finish.
meetingsPage.enquireLead: Tell us a little about your event and our team will prepare a tailored proposal.
meetingsPage.doneBody: Thank you. Our events team will review your request and email you a tailored proposal shortly. We look forward to hosting you at Xperience Kiroseiz Parkland.

contactPage.heroSub: A new dynamic Egyptian hospitality brand — international standards with regional warmth. Our teams across Sharm El Sheikh and Cairo are ready to help.
contactPage.headLead: Tell us what you need and the right team will reply within one business day.
contactPage.doneBody: Your message has been sent. Our team will get back to you within one business day. We look forward to welcoming you to Xperience.
contactPage.addressVal: 51 El Multaqa Al Araby St., Sheraton, Cairo, Egypt
contactPage.locLead: Select a destination to view it on the map and reach the team directly. For Hill Top Beach & Golden Sandy Beach, contact our central reservations.
contactPage.socialLead: Follow us for Red Sea offers, resort news and a little daily sunshine.
